alex.d: Heads-up — I ran into a subtle v1->v2 migration gap: model alias fallback ordering changed after the v2.1.2 runtime tweak. The migration guide currently implies aliases are preserved verbatim; we should add a small note + example showing current fallback semantics.

maria.p: Can you paste the minimal request that failed? Which SDKs hit this?

alex.d: Here’s the curl I used that hit the confusion:
```
POST /v2/generate
{
  "model": "rl-alpha:prod-alias",
  "input": "summarize: ..."
}
```
In v1 the alias would resolve to `rl-alpha:prod-alias` -> `rl-alpha-v3` reliably. In v2 the catalog mapping prefers base-model tag first, so clients without explicit alias resolution can get `rl-alpha-v2`.

sam.t: Seen this in Python and TS SDK e2e. The SDKs call the catalog endpoint differently now, so fallback order changed. I have a failing test reproducer.

jules (docs-bot): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3456 — adds a migration note under "Model aliases and fallback" and example snippets for py/ts. @sam.t can you smoke test the python snippet?

sam.t: Will do. Quick note: TS snippet needs param rename (model -> modelName) after the recent param rename patch; I'll push a tiny edit.

sam.t: Quick results: python snippet passes locally, TS snippet updated in PR. Left one inline comment about code fence language.

eli.s: Also suggest we add a line about Dedicated/canary routing: alias swaps may be delayed up to cache TTL (default ~2m) — I've seen customers assume instant alias flips.

maria.p: Good call. Can we also add a one-liner in the v2 deprecation notice pointing to the migration checklist and add a redirect from the old alias doc path?

alex.d: I'm adding the redirect and a short changelog bullet. Also adding the Dedicated TTL note. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jules (docs-bot): Merged to staging at 2893457899. deploy-bot scheduled a docs deploy at 2893458920.

deploy-bot: Deployment started (staging) — watch for render diffs.

sam.t: left one nit in the PR thread; nothing blocking.

alex.d: Thanks everyone, I'll follow up if any downstream SDK followups required.
